high_level_description: The image shows two women standing side by side against a plain, light-colored background. The woman on the left is wearing a traditional Indian saree with a pink blouse underneath. The saree has a patterned border in shades of gold, silver, and blue. She has long, dark hair styled in loose waves and is wearing large, dangling earrings that appear to be made of green beads or stones. The woman on the right is dressed in a sleeveless black dress and is wearing a statement necklace with a large, ornate pendant. Her hair is also dark and styled in loose waves, similar to the woman on the left.
